_doc: WESTERN HEART — RANK LADDER (user-editable data). Rename tiers, add tiers, extend the S-tier list, or rename the RESERVED placeholders purely by editing this file — no code changes needed. The engine (game/js/ranks.js) reads everything here: tier order, names, sections, colors, and all promotion/demotion rules. Tiers are identified by stable `id` slugs, so inserting a tier anywhere (any boundary, top included) never breaks saved player data.

rules._doc: All rank math lives here. Tekken structure: points bar per tier, promotion series when the bar fills, demotion risk when it empties, protection right after promotion.

bar._doc: Points needed to fill the bar and trigger a promotion series, by section. `default` covers any section not listed.

demotion._doc: Losing at 0 bar (with no protection left) starts a DEMOTION series (best-of-N). Lose it → rank down. Win it → safe, bar set to `seriesWinBarFrac`. `protectionMatches` after each promotion: losses can't start a demotion series.

promotion._doc: When the bar fills you enter a promotion SERIES (best-of-N). Win it → rank up. Lose it → stay, bar refills to `seriesLossBarFrac`. Tekken's 'promotion chance' as a series.

offline._doc: Offline track: rank battles vs CPU (arcade-style). Opponent tier drifts near yours; AI difficulty scales with tier.
offline.label: OFFLINE

online._doc: Online track: ranked vs humans. Local versus feeds this track until netplay ranked lands (see game/netplay). Same math, separate ladder.
online.label: ONLINE
